base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: This Product contains all Operational Qualification checks for the cobas 6800 instrument.
Please ensure that the instrument is running in service mode before starting the tests.

product:Description.base:Title: Reagent storage elevator adjustment

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: It helps to adjust the reagent storage elevator.
Preconditions:
- Reagent storage adjusted according to service documentation
- Transfer module front cover is opened
Required Time: 4 minutes
Required Equipment: Tool reagent storage lift (adjustment tool)

product:Description.base:Title: Barcode scanner calibration

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: It calibrates the barcode scanner (valid for all versions).
Precondition: Ensure the black cover is attached to the scanner before starting this check
Required Time: 7 minutes
Required Equipment: Tool calibration rack

product:Description.base:Title: Load reagents PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: It verifies that the processing module A fluidics can be loaded with reagents.
Preconditions: None
Required Time: 7 minutes
Required Equipment:
- 2 specimen diluent containers
- 2 lysis reagent containers
- 3 wash reagent containers
- In case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling, 3 liquid waste containers

product:Description.base:Title: Instrument teach 6800

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Performs the teach function of the instrument.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- The front cover of the transfer module is opened
- The teach tool is present on the teach tool park position in the transfer module
- Reagent storage elevator adjustment executed beforehand
- Transfer module drawer, processing module drawer and amplification plate waste drawer are closed
Required Time: 16 minutes
Required Equipment:
- Pre-teach tool
- Teach tool
Required bulk reagent and waste volumes (will be checked automatically and can be loaded during execution):
- 162 ml wash reagent in the wash reagent reservoir,
else 1000 ml in wash reagent container to fill the wash reagent reservoir
- 412 ml liquid waste capacity (300 ml tolerance included)

product:Description.base:Title: Extended prime check PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: This check primes the instrument.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- Processing module front cover is open
- Overflow bottle is empty
- Load reagents command is executed with the required equipment
Required Time: 20 min
Required Equipment:
- 2 tip racks
- 3 wash reagent containers (valid RFIDs)
- 2 specimen diluent bottles (valid RFIDs)
- 2 lysis reagent bottles (valid RFIDs)
- In case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling: 3 empty liquid waste containers

product:Description.base:Title: Instrument tightness check 6800

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Perform the tightness check on the instrument.
Preconditions:
- The teach tool is present on the teach tool park position of the transfer module.
- The sample transfer head, reagent transfer head, the processing transfer heads and main handler are taught.
- Service functions executed: Extended prime
- Transfer positions empty
Required Time: 10 minutes
Required bulk reagent and waste volumes (will be checked automatically and can be loaded during execution):
- 210 ml wash reagent in the wash reagent reservoir, else 910 ml in wash reagent container to fill the wash reagent reservoir
- in case of on-system liquid waste handling configuration, 460 ml liquid waste capacity (300 ml tolerance included)

product:Description.base:Title: Reagent transfer head pipetting intro PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Checks the pipetting accuracy of the reagent transfer head using the onboard weighing system.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- The front cover of the processing module is open
- The load reagent command was executed
Required Time: 5 min
Required Equipment:
- Tool onboard weighing system (OWS)
- Tool holder for onboard weighing system
Required bulk reagent and waste volumes (will be checked automatically and can be loaded during execution):
- 154 ml wash reagent in the wash reagent reservoir, else 910 ml in wash reagent container to fill the wash reagent reservoir
- 208 ml specimen diluent
- 612 ml liquid waste capacity (300 ml tolerance included)

product:Description.base:Title: Reagent transfer head OWS calibration PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Calibrates the balance.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- Processing module front cover is opened
- Reagent transfer head pipetting intro was executed
- It is recommended to have the balance powered on for 30 minutes before executing the check
Required Time: 5 minutes
Required Equipment:
- The balance
- 1 Mettler Toledo pair of tweezers
- 1 Mettler Toledo calibration standard weight (10g)
- Weighing boat
- Draft shield for weighing boat
Required consumables/reagents: None

product:Description.base:Title: Main handler handling check 6800

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: It checks that the main handler can move all consumables and cassettes to the different transfer positions.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- If a clean-up was performed and a consumable or cassette was placed into the transfer module, you have to remove it before executing this check
- The front covers of the transfer module and processing modules are opened
- No empty amplification plate cassettes loaded
- Transfer positions of transfer and processing module are empty
Required Time: 24 minutes
Required Equipment:
- 2 cobas omni amplification plate Casettes (each with 4 plates inside)
- 2 cobas omni Pipette tips
- 2 cobas omni processing plates
- 1 cobas omni MGP reagent cassette
- 1 reagent cassettes (e.g. cobas omni Training Kit)
- 1 control cassette (e.g. cobas omni Training control Kit)
NOTE: The check begins immediately after clicking the start button. Mind the moving units!
WARNING: The RFID of the reagent cassette is modified and will cause reagent cassette invalidation.

product:Description.base:Title: Safety interlock check 6800

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: It checks the interlock functionality.
Preconditions:
- The instrument has to be in interlock service mode
- Auxiliary releases are closed
Required Time: 7 minutes
Required Equipment: Flat head number 1 screwdriver
